items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to privilege escalation and account takeover. It has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored XSS leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.7 that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored XSS leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.7 that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.6 that could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization (B2B Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B with a CVSS score of 7.5 that could enable a security feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (versions up to 3.16.0) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.3 and has been actively exploited.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension. A single crafted cookie on any storefront page can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Sansec observed attacks on 79.5% of all stores, and while a fix was released in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026, older supported versions remain vulnerable.
